shared_elements: carved bands or bracelets on arms/wrists
low-relief carving with linear incised detail
justification: Both depict anthropomorphic figures with headgear, banded arm ornaments and a circular disc/rosette motif associated with the body, which is the most specific shared content. But A shows multiple slender profile figures in a narrative composition, richly detailed with fringed robes, wings and plant forms plus a horizontal register of writing-like signs, while B is a single massive frontal figure whose blocky, schematic body occupies the whole surface with only a few incised outlines; the depictive conventions and compositional logic are quite different.
